text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I came to the shrine with Sakura Laurel, who hasn't been in the best shape lately. First, the two of us offer our prayers.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
――Well now. Finished my prayer...
Maybe I'll draw a fortune♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you drawing a fortune too, Laurel-san? The fortunes here really come true~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! If it has Fukukitaru-chan's stamp of approval,
then all the more reason to draw!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I got a pretty good result!
How about you, Laurel-san?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Umm...
It says, "Terrible Luck. Beware of lost items in particular."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: G-G-G-Great Curse?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hawawawawa, this is terrible! An 'Extremely Bad Luck' fortune... Does this mean a storm of misfortunes and troubles is coming for Laurel-san~~!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh Gods, Buddhas, and Shiraoki-sama! Please, please,
protect Laurel-san from terrible bad luck!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru-chan... thank you!
That's so reassuring. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from the shrine.
Sakura Laurel didn't seem to care about the fortune slip's results at all.
choice_data_list: You're surprisingly cheerful for someone who drew the worst fortune.
You're surprisingly cheerful for someone who drew the worst fortune.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... I think drawing "Great Curse" on a fortune
is a warning from the gods. Like they're saying,
"Bad things are about to happen~!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If you look at it that way, you can prepare yourself for the worst.
So I'm actually really grateful for it!
choice_data_list: I see, that's just like Laurel.
I see, that's so like Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, Fukukitaru-chan prayed to the gods
for me too... Huh?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —...Your wallet is missing?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel looks for her wallet, but can't find it.
Suddenly, the fortune slip's warning,
"Beware of lost items," flashes through my mind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I dropped it between the shrine and here.
Either way, I'll search for it on my way back!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I found the wallet!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's all thanks to noticing it right away!

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
French imported goods shop "Iris" is open today!
Please do come and take a look!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? A new shop opened up here!
Whoa, this looks fun...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
When we went back to get the wallet,
we ended up discovering a wonderful little shop, didn't we?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turning misfortune into a blessing. Thanks in part to that,
Sakura Laurel was able to regain her top form.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“—No good. It's not here either...
Where did it go?”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I really should've been more careful!
Maybe I underestimated that "Great Curse" fortune.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: For now, I need to report this to the police box...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps affected by the Terrible Luck fortune,
Sakura Laurel was unable to regain
her form.
